passenger_response.subject: Update on booking AER-7P4R2M
passenger_response.body:
Dear Kenneth Braithwaite,

The record shows that flight AK150 on 2026-08-06 was cancelled because of a nosewheel steering fault. The aircraft was withdrawn, and there was no further FCO service that date.

A hotel room at LGW has been arranged for the night of 2026-08-06.

Compensation cannot be assessed yet because you have not been re-routed, so the arrival delay at your final destination is not known. It can be assessed once your re-routing, or refusal of re-routing, is settled.

We could not verify your request to change the booking or issue a benefit. Please confirm what you want us to arrange.

This needs a colleague to review it. The handover has not been completed; no decision has been made.

This needs a colleague to review it. The handover has not been completed; no decision has been made.

Your request about locating or returning your camel-coloured overcoat, which you say you left on an aircraft in March, also needs review.

Regards,
Aerlink Disruption Desk
